programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 鷺航客運飛行部副部長顧南亭（王凱飾），以嚴苛自律和鐵血上司的形象深受眾人敬畏與之形成鮮明對比的是貨運女飛行員程霄（譚松韻飾），她性格爽朗不羈，即將晉升機長的她卻因公司改制被降至客運部的觀察員，重新踏上飛行之路命運的玩笑是，顧南亭成了程霄的直屬上司和導師，兩人的相遇註定了不尋常的火花ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt顧南亭習慣於秩序和規章制度，而程霄卻喜歡不按常理出牌，經常讓他應接不暇一系列突發的航空事件接踵而至，要求他們合作應對，但他們的分歧和火藥味卻似乎更加激化了每一場危機顧南亭面對這位性格如此迥異的飛行員，既感到挑戰，也因其勇敢和獨立而歎為觀止在冰火交織的挑戰中，顧南亭和程霄必須找到一種合作的默契，才能化解每一次的險情，確保安全的背後他們的故事不僅僅是師徒間的碰撞，更是對於個性與團隊合作之間微妙平衡的探索

programme.title: 好劇連場: 罰罪
programme.desc: 由黃景瑜楊祐寧李幼斌主演故事以一宗惡劣案件為切入口，通過青年刑警常征（黃景瑜飾）的視角，講述兩代公安幹警為維護一方安寧，掃除犯罪團夥，不畏艱險前赴後繼的英勇故事在昌武（虛構地）這座小城，在危機重重的戰鬥第一線，刑偵大隊副大隊長常征因長期追查實力雄厚的趙嘯聲家族，而被捲入重重漩渦之中ampampampampampquot法大於天ampampampampampquot的信念支撐著常征堅持不懈，恪守誓言，同一眾幹警攜手共進，破解迷局

programme.title: 重生技 第二季
programme.desc: 隨著現代高科技的發展，文保工作者們面臨著一場科技賦能的全新體驗，他（她）們利用高科技，通過透視眼無影手進行文物修復，使文物保護不再是器物表面雕琢與修補，而是對文保工作者們自身理念視角和認知的轉型升級片中揭秘八種糟朽或受損嚴重的寶藏級文物修護，記錄文物醫生打開科技新視角，踏上化腐朽為神奇的旅程，在跨學科的碰撞中，技術與藝術相伴共生，萬年永存

programme.desc: 熟年由郝蕾王鷗唐藝昕等主演的都市家庭劇該劇根據伊北同名小說改編，講述熟年一族即45歲到65歲之間的中年人，面臨內外危機和如何妥當處理危機的家庭式溫情與悲喜的故事ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt中年女人張春梅郝蕾飾的生活在外人看來堪稱完美，兒子以優異的成績考上重本；老公是教授博導，事業有成風頭正健；她自己在雜誌社副主編正有望再升一級，有房有車有存款可實際上，春梅的苦只有她自己知道中年毫無徵兆地到來，跟著一起來的，還有危機，丈夫偉強失蹤了春梅盤點各種蛛絲馬跡，認定偉強出軌，然而當偉強終於好似想通回家的時候，卻向春梅提出離婚當然，中年的危機可不止這一樁，當重重困難砸在春梅頭上的時候，她開始思考要如何應對生活壓力下的工作與家庭，如何讓自己坦然面對老去

programme.desc: 繼第一季小涼帽之白鷺歸來和第二季小涼帽之魔法涼帽後，再次開啟魔法小仙女的嶺南奇幻冒險之旅小涼帽3之白豚灣奇遇以嶺南文化作為切入點，側重展現海洋夢幻色彩，以自然認知家庭關愛夥伴關係和人格成長為主線，為兒童展開了一幅幅生動美麗的東方田園與海洋生活的畫卷，深入展示人與自然的聯繫，探尋人與自然的和諧相處之道故事講述小涼帽阿涼和阿妹來到了白豚灣小表哥家這裡有奇幻的秘境森林多姿多彩的海洋生物美輪美奐的海底世界，還有傳說中的海珠神女和神秘的海靈珠

programme.title: 如果奔跑是我的人生
programme.desc: 劇集改編自紀靜蓉的小說如果奔跑是我的宿命，由鍾楚曦楊超越許娣陳小藝侯雯元領銜主演 該劇透過一場車禍，講述了兩個家庭如何在人生的逆境中展現出不同的生活態度和勇氣ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt一次喜慶的壽宴後，一場意外的車禍對趙秀麗（陳小藝飾）和趙秀芳（許娣飾）的家庭造成了破壞性的打擊趙秀麗的兒子是一名成績優異的高中生，但在這場事故中不幸喪生，大女兒陳若華（楊超越飾）逃過一劫；而趙秀芳的女兒程安心（鍾楚曦飾）是一位年輕的舞蹈教師，也在這次事故中重傷失去了雙腿陳若華為了幫助母親趙秀麗從悲痛中恢復過來，將她帶到了自己的學生宿舍然而，陳若華在照顧心碎的母親和處理與周凱澤（王宥鈞飾）的戀情之間，感到極大的壓力另一方面，趙秀芳為了振奮失望的女兒程安心和逃避現實的女婿秦峰（宋洋飾），決定開始之前從未成功過的減肥隨著時間的推移，陳若華在與母親的關係中逐漸找回平衡，解開了母女之間的矛盾趙秀芳也最終成功地減掉了體重，幫助程安心重新勇敢面對生活

programme.desc: 在外地發展演藝事業取得輝煌成就的李銘順回來了！從小在郊區長大的李銘順，這次帶著滿滿的童年回憶和人生歷練來到熟悉的甘榜小屋除了與兒時的自己重聚，每集也會邀請不同嘉賓朋友一同歡聚熱愛烹飪的銘順將親自下廚款待客人做菜吃飯的同時，銘順與嘉賓少不了談天交心，分享生活，過程中品嘗的不僅是美食，還有人生各種滋味

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 鷺航客運飛行部副部長顧南亭（王凱飾），以嚴苛自律和鐵血上司的形象深受眾人敬畏與之形成鮮明對比的是貨運女飛行員程霄（譚松韻飾），她性格爽朗不羈，即將晉升機長的她卻因公司改制被降至客運部的觀察員，重新踏上飛行之路命運的玩笑是，顧南亭成了程霄的直屬上司和導師，兩人的相遇註定了不尋常的火花ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt顧南亭習慣於秩序和規章制度，而程霄卻喜歡不按常理出牌，經常讓他應接不暇一系列突發的航空事件接踵而至，要求他們合作應對，但他們的分歧和火藥味卻似乎更加激化了每一場危機顧南亭面對這位性格如此迥異的飛行員，既感到挑戰，也因其勇敢和獨立而歎為觀止在冰火交織的挑戰中，顧南亭和程霄必須找到一種合作的默契，才能化解每一次的險情，確保安全的背後他們的故事不僅僅是師徒間的碰撞，更是對於個性與團隊合作之間微妙平衡的探索

programme.title: 詩詞有故事
programme.desc: 詩篇留紙上，歲月藏字間ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt詞句訴心事，悲歡訴世間ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt細解文中意，重探舊時顏ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt詩詞有故事共讀古賢篇ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt本節目通過講述中華詩詞背後的故事，傳承民族精神，弘揚中華文化，厚植家國情懷

programme.desc: 劇集改編自紀靜蓉的小說如果奔跑是我的宿命，由鍾楚曦楊超越許娣陳小藝侯雯元領銜主演 該劇透過一場車禍，講述了兩個家庭如何在人生的逆境中展現出不同的生活態度和勇氣ampampampltbrampampampgt一次喜慶的壽宴後，一場意外的車禍對趙秀麗（陳小藝飾）和趙秀芳（許娣飾）的家庭造成了破壞性的打擊趙秀麗的兒子是一名成績優異的高中生，但在這場事故中不幸喪生，大女兒陳若華（楊超越飾）逃過一劫；而趙秀芳的女兒程安心（鍾楚曦飾）是一位年輕的舞蹈教師，也在這次事故中重傷失去了雙腿陳若華為了幫助母親趙秀麗從悲痛中恢復過來，將她帶到了自己的學生宿舍然而，陳若華在照顧心碎的母親和處理與周凱澤（王宥鈞飾）的戀情之間，感到極大的壓力另一方面，趙秀芳為了振奮失望的女兒程安心和逃避現實的女婿秦峰（宋洋飾），決定開始之前從未成功過的減肥隨著時間的推移，陳若華在與母親的關係中逐漸找回平衡，解開了母女之間的矛盾趙秀芳也最終成功地減掉了體重，幫助程安心重新勇敢面對生活

programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 스카페이스

programme.title: 노팅힐

아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.desc: 肥龍和瘦虎是一對嫉惡如仇的警探,二人在追捕毒販太子德時,毀了副警務署長的婚禮,只好離港消上司之氣.二人在新加坡認識了兩女子.在此時,犯人被保外出,聘請殺手幹掉二人,二人機智脫險,二人苦無證據控告太子德,惟有以暴易暴...

programme.title: 林中小屋粵普
programme.desc: 情人節來臨,華偉在越南的山林里度假,邀請朋友參加其生日宴會,同時給女友娜娜求婚,但是朋友在路途中撞死了一個女人和她的女兒,並且拋下她們匆匆逃匿了.當他們來到華偉住的越南山林小屋,華偉已經...

programme.title: 花花型警粵普
programme.desc: 警察麥克是個愛出風頭的富家子,常常花老爸的錢辦案,雖然破案無數,卻無法贏得警局同事以及女朋友麗莎的認同,還被大家厭煩地稱作花花型警,在發覺麗莎與來自大陸的警察林亨關係密切後,麥克心升醋意...

programme.title: 城市獵人粵
programme.desc: 孟波成龍飾,綽號城市獵人,是一位私家偵探.過去曾有一位搭檔中村王敏德客串,然而中村在一次單獨出任務時失手,臨死前將妹妹惠香王祖賢飾託付給孟波,並囑咐孟波不可以泡她.長大以後的惠香卻遠超過孟波當初的認知,讓孟波很後悔當初答應中村不泡惠香惠香成為孟波的助手,兩人的關係相當曖昧.日本報業大王今村宏次荻原賢三飾的獨生女今村清子後藤久美子飾離家出走,今村宏次得知女兒去了香...

programme.title: 男兒當入樽粵普
programme.desc: 籃球健兒灌男在球場上以波牛見稱,因愛慕琪琪而加入其父的籃球隊.集訓期間灌男結識同道好友波神高秋.球隊即將迎戰美國哈林勁隊黑森林,爭奪超級籃球爭霸盃.他們如何贏取冠軍,還有夢中情人的芳心?

programme.title: 愛上百分百英雄粵普
programme.desc: 主角飛機鄭伊健飾本是一名上進積極之探員,但是在一次保護污點証人的過程中遇上了殺手天使方中信飾將証人及其女友殺掉,飛機雖然逃過大難,自此便性情大變...

programme.title: 飛鷹計劃粵
programme.desc: 故事講述第二次世界大戰時納粹德軍於非洲沙漠隱藏了240噸黃金,飛鷹Jackie與助手Ada,德國少女Elsa及桃子一行人受命尋找.他們千辛萬苦到達藏金地點,但這裏不只有黃金,還有一連串未解之謎等着他們.

programme.title: 邊緣人粵普
programme.desc: 邊緣人在影片中的意思是暗指臥底,這部當年在香港社會引起廣泛關注的新浪潮電影,也是今日黑幫臥底片的鼻祖.電影講述阿潮自幼長在三教九流的黑社會盤踞區,中學畢業毅然投考警校,決心與黑社會對抗.阿潮被警方派往黑社會臥底,雖遭不少挫折,仍屢建奇功,得到上司的賞識.阿潮因為工作關係,被迫與女友阿芳疏遠,最終導致其愛情的斷送,卻並未使阿潮對自己的這項工作消極氣餒.但當阿潮看到一同出生入死的邊緣人阿泰因...

programme.title: 殭屍家族粵
programme.desc: 古董商郭敦煌鍾發飾在古墓中盜走了三具殭屍,意外弄醒殭屍父張榮祥飾,母王玉環飾並不慎放走了小殭屍何健威飾而招禍,中醫師林正英林正英飾發現奕豬膽樓南光飾身中屍毒,故與其女兒阿芝李賽鳳飾及記者男友夏友仁元彪飾尋找殭屍下落.女童嘉嘉韓詩雨飾誤會小殭屍是人蛇,收留房中並成為好友.其父胡胡楓飾發現後大驚,遂向警方求助,怎料殭屍父母竟殺入胡家.

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: Documentary examining paranormal activity, beginning with he Enfield Poltergeist, a series of strange events that occurred at a council house in north London in 1977. Police were called to investigate reports of a burglary, but found no evidence of a break-in, but heard rapping on the walls, saw furniture tilt independently and a chair slide several metres across the room on its own. These were the first of many extraordinary events recorded on film and audio tape, culminating in disembodied voices and levitation

programme.title: Hauntings

Their investigations led to a sance, which changed the lives of the Perron family

Alans sloppy bricklaying skills are put to the test when Scott ropes him in to try to build a traditional cooker hood, but Amanda is unimpressed with the result. programme.title: Amanda Alans Spanish Job

programme.desc: When Po discovers he was poisoned, he sets off to a caravan oasis in the hopes of finding out who the perpetrator is, unknowingly followed by the kid

programme.title: The Tangled Web
programme.desc: Tom and DAngelo must come together to help Alex and Jun escape the clutches of the Spiderwings.

programme.title: Follow the Lightning: Part 1
programme.desc: Tom and the riders go in search of Thunder and must face a gauntlet of dangerous dragons to find their lost friend. Along the way, Tom reveals his big secret to DAngelo and Alex.

programme.title: Shockarachnids
programme.desc: Dozer and Skya work together to find their way home after they are attacked by Shockarachnids, jumper-cable-like snakes with high-voltage bites

programme.title: Scaretrux
programme.desc: Revvit and the Reptools are trapped by Scraptors and create a fake T-Truxto scare them away, only to then have Skrap-It attempt to steal it

programme.title: Cat Fish
programme.desc: When pirates force Puss to face his fear of water by walking the ships plank, he is rescued by his ex-girlfriend and fish monster, Feejee the Mermaid.

programme.title: Parrot Booty
programme.desc: When Puss and the pirates find the treasure of San Luis Rey, they must find a way to escape the attack of Bonky the Parrot and his skeleton army.

programme.title: Stingo Cleans Up
programme.desc: Diggly has had enough of the heap of unwanted items next to his compost heap. Stingo decides to resell them to the other tots and unwittingly helps everybody out!

programme.title: My Fair Bumble
programme.desc: Bumble has been asked to Aunt Tulips for tea but he is worried that his manners are not up to scratch. He asks the other tots to help him out.

programme.title: Pineapple Palace Panic
programme.desc: Fifi is supposed to be babysitting Grubby, but shes forgotten! Stingo and Slugsy step in to cover for her, with disastrous results!

programme.title: Poppys Big Race
programme.desc: It is the day of the annual Flowertot Race. Poppy is reluctant to enter as she always loses her way. Fifi and Bumble help her train for the big race, but will she win?

programme.title: Blueberry Hunt
programme.desc: Fifi and Bumble are off to pick all the ripe blueberries off the bush. But when they get there all the berries have disappeared. Who could have taken them?

programme.title: Snowtime For Pip
programme.desc: All Pip wants to do is play in the snow. Fifi tries to help him out, and come up with a brilliant idea how they can without it actually snowing!

programme.title: Pet Project Mission Improbable
programme.desc: When Mr. Tanaka adopts an unruly dog at Sams behest, the Zenkos have the job of training the mischievous mutt and turning him into mans best friend material. When Ellies friend Maria is late submitting her painting to the art show, its up to the Zenkos to get inside the community center after hours, avoiding overzealous junior security Rodney, and get Marias painting on display before the show starts.

programme.title: An Inconvenient Tooth Up, Up and Away
programme.desc: After Lula loses her loose tooth in the park, Team Zenko must find the missing molar and get it under Lulas pillow in time for the Tooth Fairys visit. Gabriel and Luis show off their new drone but it crash lands on the roof top. Team Zenkos mission is to try and get it back, but Yolanda wont give up her new hi-tech friend that easily.

programme.title: Olivia The Nature Photographer
programme.desc: After snapping some great photos of her cat Edwin, Olivia thinks shes ready to photograph some real wild animals. She and Julian camp out in the backyard to wait for some, and sure enough they track down a mysterious animal in the bushes. But is it really a wild beast?

programme.title: The Two Olivias
programme.desc: Theres a new girl in Olivias class and her name is...Olivia! Confusion ensues, and Olivia the original Olivia cant believe that she shares her name with another person. After a brief stint calling herself Pam, Olivia eventually decides that a two Olivia town might not be so bad after all.

programme.title: Olivias Day At The Office
programme.desc: When Father takes Olivia and Ian to bring your kids to work day, Olivia is looking forward to a fun day with dad at the office. But when Father is given a new deadline for a big project, Olivia hatches a plan to help him out. First, however they have to track down Ians missing frog.

programme.title: Olivia Helps Mother Nature
programme.desc: After learning about the environment, Olivia is on a mission to recycle, cut down on waste, and conserve energy. But she just cant get Ian to turn off his light at night. Either shell have to find a way for Ian to fall asleep without it, or else find a sustainable alternative

programme.title: Mad-Dog McSneer Our Boy Wolfie
programme.desc: Mad Dog McSneer All the Scare School students have to do a presentation on a famous figure of the Underworld, and Casper ends up having to present the famous Wailing Mad Dog McSneer in person! Only problem: He doesnt even know him! He discovers, with Ra and Manthas help, that McSneer is none other than the old Nightwatchman, who isnt as frightening as he used to be Our Boy Wolfie A misunderstanding leads Jimmys parents to believe that their son has turned into a werewolf, and Wolfie ends

programme.title: Ghost Writer The Ghost Magnet
programme.desc: Ghost Writer Casper and Jimmys favourite scary stories author is in Deedstown to sign his latest book. He admits to them that hes got writers block and will never ever write another one!! Disaster, Jimmy LOVES those books... Casper decides to take matters in his own hands and shows him what a real ghost looks like. But things get out of hand and the terrified writer stumbles through the dimension tube and ends up in Scare School! Will Casper manage to get him out of there before students an

programme.title: Tea Times Up Barks, Baths, and Beyond
programme.desc: When Athena thinks Lola no longer wants to have their weekly tea party, a tradition theyve had as long as Athena can remember, Athena tries everything she can to get Lola to have another one. When Tracy and Harper accidentally leave Wilford at home, on their way to the Fairhaven Pet Get Together, its up to the Dew Drops to get him to the park on time. But because it just rained, getting Wilford there clean proves to be a challenge.

programme.title: The Secret Ingredient Delete That Dew!
programme.desc: When Harper is missing an ingredient to make her Moms favorite dessert on Mothers Day, Eden enlists the help of her fellow Dew Drops to do an emergency city-wide ingredient search! When Marcus records a video of his inventions, Phoebe gets caught on camera and must erase the footage before Marcus sees, or her Dew Drop cover will be blown!

programme.title: Berry Race The Artist
programme.desc: The kids have a race to decide who gets to try some extremely rare berries. When Scallop finds a beautiful and mysterious sea sculpture, she enlists the help of her friends to search the sea for the artist behind the masterpiece.

programme.title: Winkly Fest Snow
programme.desc: When Pixie struggles to recreate an old tradition perfectly, the kids realize they can make their own traditions. A story told by Chef J inspires Juniper to go in search of snow.

programme.title: Happy Birthday Pawston
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch embark on a road trip to Chew York City to track down Kelly Korgi to ask her to perform at Pawstons 100th birthday party. When Kelly Korgi tells Tag she cant perform at Pawstons 100th birthday party, she and Scooch decide to create a Kelly Korgi replacement so that she doesnt break her promise to the town.

programme.title: Big Dog Job The Case of the Slobbery
programme.desc: Tag tries to prove to Mom that shes a big dog by puppysitting Yip and Rhonda all day. All she has to do is get them to the playground, but the pups keep running off. When a giant, bone-shaped, roller coaster ride goes missing from the Amusement Bark, Detectives Tag and Scooch take on the case of the slobbery robbery.

programme.title: Grumblegard, Part 1
programme.desc: While the others care for baby dragons at the roost, Dak, Winger, Burple and Aggro come face-to-face with a grumpy old dragon on a dangerous island.

programme.title: Grumblegard, Part 2
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders plan to team up with the Slinkwings when an angry Grumblegard threatens Huttsgalor. But their old enemies may be up to new tricks.

programme.title: The First Lost Tooth
programme.desc: When Melman loses his first tooth, he fears he wont be Kates baby anymore and goes on a city-wide chase to recover his tooth before Kate can replace him with a younger, cuter animal.

programme.title: The Lone Park Ranger
programme.desc: When Ranger Hoof invites Marty on a Junior Ranger night trot in Central Park, Marty is determined to prove hes got what it takes to do the job- but when Alex tags along for the ride, Marty learns that what it takes is a whole lot of teamwork.

programme.title: Model Behavior Pillow Fight Club
programme.desc: Satin and Chenille put on a fashion show to impress the trendsetter of Troll VillagePoppy and Branch start a massive villagewide pillow battle to determine who gets the pillow of destiny.

programme.title: The Imposter Frenemy
programme.desc: When there is an imposter in Troll Village, Branch and Poppy embark on a man-hunt as to try to keep the Trolls from realizing that anything is offPoppy discovers that Archer Pastry belongs to a group of evil creatures called the Party Crashers

programme.title: Cast Out Part 1
programme.desc: After disobeying orders, Snotlout is expelled from the academy. Meanwhile, Alvin comes to Berk to make amends- but can he be trusted?

programme.title: Cast Out Part 2
programme.desc: Hiccup and the gang must rescue Stoick with assistance from Berks archenemy Alvin.

programme.title: Race To The Finish Part 1
programme.desc: The girls get summer jobs to help Lucky repair the sprawling house she inherited from her grandfather near the Rosemead Valley Racetrack.

programme.title: Race To The Finish Part 2
programme.desc: Determined to save her family home, Lucky signs up to race as a wild card in Rosemeads elite Junior Cup. But winning it all wont be easy.

programme.title: A Thuper Hero Thtory
programme.desc: Tip and Ohs plan to save Elrod turns into a battle to save earth from Elrod

programme.title: Friend Like Tip Like Mother, Like Pit Of Fire

Though Mastodon continues to warn the team about the dangers in using the Tianshang Weapons, they use them in a fight against Klaus and Veruca. The clash of the weapons wakes a dormant volcano!

programme.title: The Mad Scientist
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blades brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 1
programme.desc: As the Dragon Knights prepare to battle for the weapons and control of Tikal, Mastodon attempts to teach Po how to access storm powers to use in the fight. Blade comes face to face with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.desc: Each kid believes that they have the best pet on the farm, and hold a contest to prove it. Meanwhile, Phils attempts to find a pet to enter proves dangerous, as he turns to wild animals.

programme.desc: The team manages to infiltrate Sudarikovs base and learn that hes building a fleet of AI cars equipped with Tonys driving ability! When the AI cars come to life, our gangs mission changes from trying to shut down the cars to just trying to survive.

programme.title: The Toretto Virus

The Toretto AI takes control of the base and begins its mission to take over the world starting with infecting nearby Bangkok. Tony realizes that the only way to stop the virus is to engage in the ultimate battle: Toretto vs. Toretto.

programme.title: MEGA Fights Sergio Gabriel Martinez vs. Serhiy Dzinziruk
programme.desc: This episode features a bout for the vacant WBC diamond middleweight title, as Sergio Gabriel Maravilla Martinez 46-2, 25 KOs takes on fellow southpaw Serhiy Dzinziruk, aka Dzyna Razor 37-0. 24 KOs. This fight took place from Foxwoods Resort Casino in Mashantucket, Connecticut, USA, on March 12, 2011. Martinez was the reigning Fighter of the Year coming into the fight and vacated his WBC Middleweight title in order to fight the undefeated former champion Dzinziruk.

programme.desc: 一心渴望加入斧头帮的小混混阿星，闯进猪笼城寨，遇上一对古怪的房东夫妇，却原来是隐世的武林高手阿星的出现，最终导致斧头帮对付房东夫妇，并引发双方一场生死大战

programme.title: 巴黎假期Paris Holiday
programme.desc: 带着破碎的心，林俊杰离开香港到法国巴黎展开新生活他透过房屋中介找到理想公寓，可是公寓却附带了一位失恋艺术家丁晓敏两个毫不相干的人住在同一屋檐下，开展了一段微妙的同居生活两人在磨擦失落体谅中互相窥探了对方最脆弱的内心，他们可否放下过去包袱，重燃对生命的热情？两人酿造的友谊又能否引领二人开花结果？

programme.title: 锁战The Locksmith
programme.desc: 锁匠山叔在意外罹患失智症后，收了爱徒程浩仁浩仁继承了山叔的精湛技艺，精通开锁，甚至青出于蓝警探刘业信经常请浩仁协助开锁，二人因此成为好友某天，浩仁偶遇多年未见的旧友，意外揭开了山叔妻子离奇失踪的真相，连串怪事亦随之而来

programme.title: 饭戏攻心Table for Six
programme.desc: 本喜剧的三兄弟同住在已故父母所留给他们的屋檐下大哥坚持每晚都要一家人一起吃饭，而当他们开始邀请各自的女朋友同住时，关系也变得非常紧张，从而引发出爱情与友情的矛盾和妒忌，及各种错综复杂的感情问题六位主角将一同饭戏攻心！

programme.title: OMG! 阿妈有喜OMG! Moms Big News
programme.desc: 53岁的Rita和丈夫计划退休，却意外怀孕，打乱了原本平静的家庭生活面对这突如其来的新生命，一场安胎之战带来连串笑料与混乱，让一家人重拾理解与包容正当一切看似平静，Rita得知胎儿疑似患有唐氏综合症，她将面临人生最艰难抉择

programme.title: 传说A Legend
programme.desc: 考古专家房教授发现冰川考察中的出土文物与他梦中见到的玉佩极为相似为揭开梦中的真相，房教授带领考察团队深入冰川，共同踏上一场奇幻冒险之旅

programme.title: 智齿Limbo
programme.desc: 一宗凶残的连环杀人案震惊全港，经验丰富的警察斩哥与年轻督察任凯被委派调查此案在调查过程中，他们遇到了王桃，并发现她意外害死了斩哥的妻子为了赎回过失，王桃决定协助他们追捕连环杀手，却最终将自己置于极大的危险之中

programme.title: 鬼才之道Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: 新晋女鬼同学必须在阴间证明自己的生存价值，因为每只鬼魂都必须有吓人业绩才能在鬼界生存无法吓人的鬼不仅拿不到猛鬼证，还可能会消失在阴间过气人气女鬼Catherine和她的经理人Makoto连手，想把同学训练成鬼界新星，让她施展最惊心动魄的吓人技俩

programme.title: 送院途中Vital Signs
programme.desc: 救护员王维调至新分局后，被安排与救护队目马志业同组执勤起初，王维因马sir的行事风格与自己差异甚大而感到不满然而，在共同经历多次任务后，马sir的处事方式让王维重新领悟到救护工作的核心，始终在于尽力拯救每一位伤者

programme.title: 百万红包A Good Fortune
programme.desc: 新加坡网红开心误坠诈骗，与母亲逃往马来西亚躲债，并重逢旧同学子豪为摆脱财务危机，两人阴差阳错地携手参加百万奖金菠萝挞大赛，在笑料百出的挑战中追寻人生福气

programme.title: 成为饭吧A Good Supper
programme.desc: 乡下小火车站周围有一家挂着饭店招牌的破旧白米饭店女高中生英信虽然是高三学生，但为了饭店的生意，骑着自行车每天急急忙忙地往市场跑，这是为了给来饭店解决一顿饭的客人准备一顿既便宜又温暖的晚餐英信从小就跟饭店老板京秀学做饮食后来饭店还来了跟着离婚的父亲，一夜之间开始了农村生活的正勋...被妈妈爸爸抛弃，被老奶奶养大的五福...还有双职工夫妇所以晚上主要在饭店吃饭的多情...这些同龄人从小时开始长达12年的晚上都聚集在饭店里吃同一桌饭，铸就了比亲兄弟更亲密的情感，比家人更紧密的联系

programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 江湖菜馆第五季 无肉不欢KungFu Licious S5 Feast of Meat
programme.desc: 江湖菜馆第五季 无肉不欢以肉为主题设立六个单元，探访新疆湖南山东北京绍兴成都襄阳长沙重庆等18座城市，深入挖掘肉食江湖和市井烟火气Food docu KungFu Licious returns with a fifth season to venture into the streets and alleys of 18 different cities, exploring meat-loving hotspots this time round and presenting the pleasures of meat through a huge variety of local meat delicacies.

programme.title: 川味 5 一宴千年Legendary Taste of Sichuan S5

Through seasonal cuisine, local flavours, customs, and landscapes, it celebrates the regions rich culinary legacy.

programme.title: 八尺门的辩护人Port of Lies
programme.desc: 某个平静的夜里，基隆八尺门地区发生灭门血案一名印尼渔工将阿美族船长一家三口残杀至死与死者出身同部落的公设辩护人佟宝驹，被迫站在族人对立面，受命为渔工辩护佟宝驹带领法院替代役及通晓嫌犯语言的印尼籍看护组成辩护小组，层层深入案情，竟牵扯出官商勾结的共犯结构这部以法律题材为主轴的迷你剧在2024年的金钟奖囊括了7个奖项，包括最佳迷你剧集编剧配乐及最佳男主角奖On a quiet night, the captain of a fishing boat and his family are brutally murdered. All the evidence points to Abdul-Adl, an Indonesian fishing worker. Tong, a public defendant of the same Amis origin of the captain, is appointed to go against his community to defend the suspect. However, all is not as it seem...

programme.title: 真料理两锅论第二季Lets Guo S2
programme.desc: 料理实境节目真料理两锅论由邰智源罗时丰黄镫辉KID林柏升温妮丘涵共同主持节目中主持人们将分为两组PK对决，亲自出马找寻稀有食材超强主厨及传奇秘方与菜单，献上最美味的完美料理Cooking reality show Lets Guo is hosted by Taiwanese artistes Tai Chih-yuan, Lo Shih-feng, Huang Chien-hui, KID Lin Po-sheng, Winnie, and Chiu Han. programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3
programme.desc: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: As the Mekong River travels down Thailands eastern border, it sculpts the land, creating hundreds of small waterways through the jungle. Take a trek though lands where rhesus macaques, elephants, and flying foxes live in harmony at the waters edge.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of troubleboth on land and in the water.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

programme.title: Stormborn Season 1
programme.desc: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

programme.title: Weird, Wild Wonderful
programme.desc: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack Season 1
programme.desc: Feel the heat as rising temps mean that water is getting scarce. The Manzi pack must stand alongside predators to hydrate at a remaining precious water spot. Hunt with Wekas pack to feed the pups, and watch the Stork Colony thrive against all odds.

programme.title: Africas Hidden Kingdoms Season 1
programme.desc: The plants and animals of the Cloud Mountains have long captured our imagination. In a landscape defined by weather and threatened by invaders, see how indigenous forests survive by providing a sanctuary for life while opening a door to the past.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea. Hop along with a colony of Snares crested penguins, soar with giant petrels and sooty shearwaters, and roar with giant sea lions.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Set sail for New Zealands Otago Peninsula, a breeding refuge for endangered seabirds and marine mammals. Watch as sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls, white-fronted terns, and fairy prions find mates, then nurture the next generation.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealands South Island, where one of the worlds longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Take a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf, near Auckland, New Zealand, and explore a true paradise for ocean creatures. Catch a glimpse of a stealthy manta ray, enjoy dolphin antics, and admire a kaleidoscope of tropical fish.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand. Swim with a pod of bottlenose dolphins, join short-tailed stingrays on a hunt, and feel the tension as a gang of predatory orcas arrives on the scene.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young. Witness giant clams and green turtles thriving in the islands massive coral reef and get a glimpse into our evolutionary past.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3
programme.desc: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3
programme.desc: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koalas spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelles slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3
programme.desc: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Brees clutch of python eggs hatch.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3
programme.desc: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3
programme.desc: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive Season 1
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive Season 1
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon Season 1
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast Season 1
programme.desc: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast Season 1
programme.desc: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast Season 1
programme.desc: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

programme.title: My Lovely Angel
programme.desc: Jae Shik, who has lived as a loner his entire life, begins to live together with a child with a hearing-visual disability, as they change each others lives and try to find a way to communicate.

programme.title: Love My Scent
programme.desc: After wearing a perfume he receives from a stranger, Chang-Soo earns the ability to attract every woman in the world. Ara begins to sense the scent of Chang-Soo and falls in love with him.

programme.title: Men of Plastic
programme.desc: A natural-born networker spot potential for business when he met a top plastic surgeon by chance. Together, they decided to open a whole new era of Apgujeong.

programme.title: Return of the Mafia
programme.desc: 10 years ago, the mafia family welcomed the entrepreneur Dae-suh as the son-in-law. They set up a company and Dae-Suh becomes the president. The family plot a conspiracy against him...

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Ui-gang, a retired hitman, reluctantly agrees to take care of a teen-aged girl Yoon-ji, but when she becomes involved with unsavory people, he shows up to rescue her and take her home.

programme.title: Split
programme.desc: Cheol-jong was once a legendary bowler, but an accident ended his career. He later teams up with an autistic genius bowling player Young-hoon and bookmaker Hee-jin to make money.

programme.title: Steel Rain: Summit
programme.desc: A peace summit for Korea is derailed when the leaders of South Korea, North Korea and the U.S. are abducted by North Korean hardliners and held hostage in a submarine.

programme.title: Gyeong-ahs Daughter
programme.desc: After her husband passed away, Gyeong-ah relies on her daughter Yeon-su. But they barely meet each other. One day, Gyeong-ah gets an anonymous message about Yeon-su and goes into trauma...

programme.title: Picnic
programme.desc: Eun-sim is an elderly living alone in Seoul. She heads to her hometown after decades away. Her long-lost memories come to life one by one. This could be the start of one last picnic...

programme.title: New World
programme.desc: An undercover cop spends eight years to infiltrate South Koreas largest crime organization. When the head of the organization is killed, he becomes torn between his loyalties.

programme.title: Concrete Utopia
programme.desc: Seoul has laid in ruin after an earthquake, leaving one single apartment remains standing. The apartments resident representative strives to protect residents from outsiders...

programme.title: Amazon Bullseye
programme.desc: Jin-bong is a former archery medalist and forced to be an archery coach for his companys hidden motives. He meets 3 bowmen in the Amazon Rainforest and embarks on an adventure with them.

programme.title: Salmokji: Whispering Water
programme.desc: After an unidentified figure appears in the footage of Salmokji Reservoir, producer Su-in leads her crew to reshoot the site, only to encounter something lurking in the deep, dark water...

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep01
programme.desc: In 1213, Tus, Iran, a young girl named Sitara is taken in by Fatima. Though she detests studying and longs for home, Fatimas son, Muhammad, inspires her to pursue knowledge and wisdom.

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep02
programme.desc: An army led by Tolui, the fourth prince of the Mongol Empire, invades the city of Tus. The city is set ablaze, and Sitara is taken captive. A boy working for the Mongols approaches her.

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep03
programme.desc: Sitara learns why Fatima was murdered and why Elements was taken. Granted an audience with Tolui, Sitara introduces herself as Fatima. Thus begins her revenge against the Mongol Empire.

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep04
programme.desc: With hatred in her heart, Sitara becomes a tutor to Sorghaghtani. Years later, amid major shifts in the political landscape after Genghis Khans death, Sitara receives an unexpected order.

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep05
programme.desc: Sitara is tasked by Sorghagtani with investigating Chagatai. But then, Sitara is accused of theft by Toregene for possessing a Jada Stone and is subjected to a harsh interrogation.

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep06
programme.desc: 13th century, Iran. Sitara, an orphan, is taken in by Fatima, who teaches her the importance of knowledge. The Mongol Empires reign later takes everything away from her as she vows revenge...

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep07
programme.desc: Sitara joins forces with Toregene in seeking revenge against the Empire. After Toregene uncovers ogedeis war plans, Sitara plots to divide the Great Khan ogedei and Military General Tolui.

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep08
programme.desc: Recognised for her intelligence, Sitara aids the court scribes and wins Empress Boraqchins favour by diagnosing her illness. Meanwhile, Sitaras plans to tear the Empire apart advance.

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep09
programme.desc: The Mongol Empire emerge victorious in the war against the Jin Dynasty despite being outnumbered. Amidst this, Toregene starts avoiding Sitara. Unsettled, Sitara secretly investigates, but...

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep10
programme.desc: Tolui is struck by an unexpected tragedy. Now, as more power concentrates within ogedeis clan, Sitara races to rescue Toregene, who has been driven into a corner by Boraqchins schemes.

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep11
programme.desc: Boraqchins past is revealed, showing how far she would go to eliminate threats to ogedei, using even her body as a test for poison. Meanwhile, Sitara meets Guyuk, Toregene and ogedeis son.

programme.title: Jaadugar: a Witch in Mongolia Ep12
programme.desc: Sorghaghtani refuses a political marriage to Guyuk, hindering Boraqchins power schemes. Meanwhile, Sitara finds a clue while searching for Toregene. ogedei summons Sitara proposing a wager.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD Ep07

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Ira terkesan dengan sindiran Tengku Shahidan dan memarahi Reez. Reez pula menegur sikap bapanya yang dilihat sengaja menyakiti hati Ira. Sementara itu. Ira terperanjat apabila dia diperkenalkan dengan Hans yang menjadi pemandu baru keluarga Rashid! Ira menyatakan bantahannya kepada Rashid tetapi Rashid menyatakan Hans adalah seorang lelaki yang jujur dan boleh dipercayai. Tengku Shahidan menemui Rashid dan menasihati Rashid supaya menjauhkan Ira dari anaknya Reez dan mahu pertunangan mereka dibatalkan. Rashid sangat tertekan dan dia jatuh sakit lagi. Hans menjadi penyelamat kali ke dua dan membawa Rashid pulang ke rumah. Rashid tidak sampai hati untuk memberitahu Ira tentang pertunangannya yang duputuskan oleh bapa Reez. Ketika Reez datang bertemu dengan Rashid, perbualan mereka didengari oleh Ira. Ira terperanjat apabila mendengar Rashid tidak lagi membenarkan Reez bertemu dengannya!

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Antasya dan Syarfan megimbas kembali segala memori. Drai saat mereka bertemu, terdampar di pulau, terpisah dan Antasya hampir dibunuh. Namun akhirnya kembali bersama dan berkahwin. Syarfan berjanji akan sentiasa menyintai Antasya dan mengharungi masa sukar bersama sehingga ke akhirnya.

Jamil mahu beredar ketika pengawal belum habis menyoalnya, Jamil mengatakan dia mahu cari cahaya misteri iaitu gelung untuk kembali ke zaman asalnya. Pengawal itu terdiam di situ, dia tidak dapat fikir dari mana sebenarnya Jamil ini datang. Jamil dapat melarikan diri selepas berjaya memperdayakan pengawal itu dengan helahnya yang bersahaja.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Just Love
programme.desc: Judge KO HEI MAN HSUAN JESSICA HESTER and KOT KWOK KWONG CHAN KAM HUNG, SUNNY have agreed that MAN will concentrate on her career while KWONG will be taking care of the housework after they get married. Everything is in harmony until KWONGs father discovers MAN and KWONGs pre-marriage written agreement. Their relationship complicates ever since. To make things worse, KWONG breaks the agreement and demands to have his own career. MAN does not pay much attention at first until she finds out that KWONG, who is free from family burden, is having an affair. MAN learns to become more affectionate in the hope of saving the marriage. Unfortunately, the whole situation deteriorates when KWONG decides that MAN is too close to her ex-boyfriend, TAI CHI HUNG WANG CHIEH, DAVE, who is now MANs colleague. Who has the right to decide who should be in charge of earning money instead of running the family?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam John Chiang is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In Julian Cheung and Kun Hao Kuan Ron Ng, to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying Kelly Cheung, Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan Samantha Ko. Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wans boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wans hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao Ins relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: Global View, curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspectivebroadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: Mystic Nine tells the story of Zhang Qishan William Chan and Wu Laogou Joseph Zeng joining forces with Huo Xiangu Chen Yao and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps Whats On Today
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam John Chiang is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In Julian Cheung and Kun Hao Kuan Ron Ng, to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying Kelly Cheung, Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan Samantha Ko. Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wans boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wans hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao Ins relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: Hosted by Moses Chan and Katy Kung, Big Feast Duel follows a team of food enthusiasts and celebrity judges exploring iconic eateries and signature dishes across the Greater Bay Area to crown the regions top culinary spots.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Mean Talk
programme.desc: The brand-new, unconventional talk show Mean Talk hosts Bob Lam and Elena Kong invite celebrity guests each episode to boldly speak the truth in the most Mean way. Content includes the most frustrating experiences since entering the industry, the most unbelievable entertainment secrets, the most blunt and provocative remarks, and the most scandalous programs of their film and television careers! To qualify as Mean Talk, guests must lower their standards and be Mean to others. Before the interview, guests must sign a Mean Confession Voucher, promising to reveal their true feelings, answer randomly selected questions honestly, and speak the truth anonymously!

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord Moses Chan. However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam Nancy Wu and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok Matthew Ho to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning Kelly Cheung. A war on drugs again breaks out

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, Group friend listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the islands heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the shows spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the citys corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates.

programme.title: Super Fun in Macau
programme.desc: Matthew Ho, along with members of the girl group MYNTSabrina Mendes,Carmen Ngai ,Ellyn Ngai ,Hilary Chong,Chelsea Mason and Skylar Lodeeply explored the streets and alleys of Macau, embarking on a fun-filled journey that combines innovative cuisine, century-old shops, unique crafts, and entertaining activities. Through competitions involving food preparation, puzzle challenges, photo opportunities, and historical research, the members will guide viewers to unlock hidden gems, charming shops, nostalgic establishments, and trendy landmarks throughout Macau. The event will also introduce Macaus unique leisure bus routes and attractions along the way, as well as the newly launched Macau History Exploration Guide, allowing everyone to experience the cultural charm of various historical sites.

programme.title: Mighty Baby
programme.desc: A world-class bra company, which had previously only employed women, made an unprecedented move by hiring two men as chief designers in response to increasingly fierce competition from its peers, aiming for a breakthrough in product development. Johnny Lau Ching-wan and Wayne Louis Koo, two men who initially knew nothing about bras, learned everything about bras and, more importantly, the true meaning of love and care after joining the company.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces.

programme.title: Hong Kong Good Take
programme.desc: Twelve TVB artists step into the dubbing booth to re-render famous lines and high-drama scenes from classic series such as A Kindred Spirit, Heart of Greed, and The Greed of Man. Contestants must synchronize lip movements, match exact timing, and deliver intense emotional voice performancesranging from hysterical crying and rapid-fire arguments to comedic character impressionscompeting for the title of Top Voice Performer.

programme.title: The Elites Talk
programme.desc: The Elites Talk features top business leaders and entrepreneurs sharing insights on market trends, corporate leadership, and industry growth across Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the King of Ghosts Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of Spirit Connection, with the team closely following live broadcasts,
